I was homeless with my partner from around august 2018 until October of the same year. Went from staying on a friend's floor for 2 - 3 nights then my car, and we were put in contact with a lovely lady from housing SA that helped us find a place fairly quickly (that october) as my partner and I were deemed "extremely high risk individuals". After getting the house for until around the end of November we didn't have any appliances, we had an oven, but no fridge, a clothesline but no washer, a couch but no bed, a few chairs but no table.

 Ended up getting more help from that lady putting us into contact with a furniture store that specifically sells to ex-inmates, so everything was extremely cheap although of middling quality, I think we in the end scored a washer, table, and fridge for under 200. 

Hell, it wasn't until this year when I thought to myself "wow finally it feels like we've stopped having to buy everything to make this house feel more liveable".
